violations.description: Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not stored in a clean, dry location a minimum of 6 inches above the floor. Cases of food was stored on the floor in the walk in cooler.

Refrigerated Storage. — --Refrigerator or cold storage was insufficient or ineffective at maintaining potentially hazardous food at a temperature of 41F or less. The under the griddle cooler was not holding chicken and hamburger at 41 F or below.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Ventilation hood system was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required.
Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was used for purpose other than handwashing. Cleaning supplies were stored in the handwashing sink.

Food display and service. — --Potentially hazardous food was not kept at an internal temperature of 41F or below during display or service. Chicken and beef in a cooler under the griddle maintained an internal temperature of 49 F
